solver_notes: Metadata repo crossbeam-rs/crossbeam is inconsistent with the Linux C target; this is a native Linux regression implementation, not a claimed crossbeam patch. Workers register EPOLLIN|EPOLLEXCLUSIVE on nonblocking SO_REUSEPORT listeners and drain accept4 until EAGAIN. SO_REUSEPORT provides lock-free kernel socket selection; EPOLLEXCLUSIVE suppresses duplicate epoll wakeups. The legacy negative control intentionally shares one listener without EPOLLEXCLUSIVE to expose the herd. All evidence executed on physical aarch64; no upstream repository patch is claimed. file_sha256_of_this_json is SHA-256 of the compact JSON preimage with this digest field empty.
